usages.explain: Used when advising or requesting the use of a specific method or means to achieve a concrete result.

examples.content: 君が死んだ方がいいと思うなら死ねばいい。
examples.transcription: きみがしんだほうがいいとおもうならしねばいい。
examples.mean: If you think it's better to die, just die.

examples.content: どうして私に頼むの、自分でやればいいじゃない。
examples.transcription: どうしてわたしにたのむの、じぶんでやればいいじゃない。
examples.mean: Why ask me? Wouldn't it be better to do it yourself?

usages.synopsis:
N + なら（ば）いい
Na + なら（ば）いい
A－ければいい
V－ばいい

usages.explain: Note: It has the same meaning as [たらいい] and can be used interchangeably, but [ばいい] carries additional meanings. Depending on the context, it can also convey a tone of indifference, such as "it doesn't matter to the speaker" or "how can you not know such a simple thing?"

title: ... ばいい => should; can; it'd be good if ~
